n: Twinkl KS1 Outdoor Unplugged Coding Cards Treasure Hunt
t: Printable arrow cards for an outdoor treasure hunt coding game for ages 5 to 7.
steps: Find the Twinkl KS1 Outdoor Unplugged Coding Cards Treasure Hunt page.
Check whether it needs a membership or a payment.
Print the cards and cut them out.
Place the start, finish and obstacle cards outdoors.
Show children how to lay arrow cards to make a route.
Let a partner follow the route.
